description: This file defines the FilterRepository class, which handles parsing filter parameters from HTTP requests within the SuiteCRM API. It interacts with the FilterParser and creates SuiteBeanResource instances, serving as a component in the API's filtering mechanism.

classes.name: FilterRepository
classes.description: Handles retrieval and parsing of filter criteria from API requests, providing methods to convert request filters into usable data structures and resources.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Parses filter parameters from an HTTP request object, returning an array of filter criteria after processing the 'filter' query parameter, or throws an exception if filter data is invalid.

methods.name: toSuiteBeanResource
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of SuiteBeanResource initialized with the container dependencies.
